title: IncuBrix CreatorOps Platform Tamil Poster

copy.headline: உங்களின் படைப்பாற்றல் உலகம்
copy.support: உள்ளடக்கத்தை உருவாக்குங்கள், மறுபயன்பாடு செய்யுங்கள் மற்றும் பல தளங்களில் வெளியிடுங்கள்.

concept: A warm and elegant representation of a creator's workflow hub, showing connected nodes for discovery, creation, repurposing, and publishing in rich vector style.

design_system.style: warm vector illustration with rich layered gradients, glowing nodes, and soft shadows
design_system.lighting: top-left warm amber light casting soft directional shadows and rim highlights

composition.hero: A central glowing golden orb connected by smooth curved gradient lines to four floating rounded rectangular nodes, each representing a content creation stage with an abstract icon.
props: floating sparkle stars in the top right
soft glowing dust motes around the central hub
tiny diamond glints near the nodes
subtle light beams emanating from the top-left
composition.background: Deep warm charcoal to rich terracotta gradient with a large subtle glowing aura behind the central hero.
decor: large faint overlapping circles at the bottom corners
subtle diagonal gradient lines across the upper third
